main.remarks: Controls generation behavior for tool manifest initializer registration code.

property.name: RegisterModuleInitializer
property.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the generated assembly should register and bind manifests from a module initializer.

property.name: CompanionNamespace
property.summary: Gets or sets the namespace used for the generated assembly manifest bootstrap companion type.
property.remarks: When not supplied, generation falls back to the default generated assembly manifest namespace.

property.name: CompanionTypeName
property.summary: Gets or sets the type name used for the generated assembly manifest bootstrap companion type.
property.remarks: When not supplied, generation falls back to the default type name derived from the assembly name.
